title: Découverte des lignes
oneGoal: Students recognize that lines are everywhere in their environment
progression: Foundation lesson - introduces the fundamental concept of lines as building blocks of visual art
realWorldConnection: Lines in classroom objects, clothing patterns, and body movements

title: Lignes avec le corps
oneGoal: Students create different types of lines using their bodies and gestures
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by making lines kinesthetic and embodied through movement
realWorldConnection: Body movements create invisible lines in dance and sports

title: Lignes émotionnelles
oneGoal: Students understand that different line qualities express different feelings
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by connecting line movements to emotional expression
realWorldConnection: How we draw when happy versus sad shows in our line quality

title: Chasse aux formes
oneGoal: Students identify basic shapes (circle, square, triangle) in their environment
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by introducing shapes as areas enclosed by lines
realWorldConnection: Shapes appear in signs, windows, wheels, and everyday objects

title: Création de lignes libres
oneGoal: Students practice making various line types with drawing tools
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by applying emotional line concepts to actual drawing
realWorldConnection: Different drawing tools create different line qualities for different purposes

title: Formes avec les mains
oneGoal: Students create shapes using finger painting and hand printing techniques
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by expanding shape vocabulary and making shapes tactile
realWorldConnection: Hands can create shapes in sand, clay, and other materials

title: Lignes racontent des histoires
oneGoal: Students use different lines to illustrate simple stories or experiences
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by using lines as narrative tools to communicate experiences
realWorldConnection: Maps use lines to show paths and journeys we take

title: Motifs avec des formes
oneGoal: Students create simple repeating patterns using basic shapes
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by organizing shapes into repeated sequences
realWorldConnection: Patterns appear in clothing, wallpaper, and nature around us

title: Lignes et nature
oneGoal: Students observe and recreate natural line patterns from plants and animals
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by finding line stories in the natural world
realWorldConnection: Tree branches, leaf veins, and animal stripes are natural line patterns

title: Formes géométriques composées
oneGoal: Students combine basic shapes to create more complex forms and objects
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by using shapes as building blocks for complex compositions
realWorldConnection: Houses, cars, and toys are made by combining basic shapes

title: Cultures et motifs
oneGoal: Students explore line and shape patterns from different cultures
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by discovering how different cultures use natural patterns
realWorldConnection: Every culture decorates objects with special line and shape patterns

title: Expression personnelle
oneGoal: Students create original artworks expressing their feelings using lines and shapes
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by combining cultural patterns with personal emotional expression
realWorldConnection: Art helps us share our feelings with others through visual language

title: Critique et appréciation
oneGoal: Students observe and discuss how lines and shapes work in artworks and daily life
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by developing critical observation skills for visual elements
realWorldConnection: Looking carefully at art and design helps us see beauty everywhere

title: Portfolio et réflexion
oneGoal: Students compile their work and reflect on their learning about lines and shapes
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by consolidating all learning into a reflective collection
realWorldConnection: Keeping artwork helps us see how our skills grow and change

title: Lignes dans l'espace
oneGoal: Students practice creating three-dimensional line sculptures with wire and pipe cleaners
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by extending line practice into three-dimensional space
realWorldConnection: Sculptors use lines in space to create artwork we can walk around

title: Formes en collage
oneGoal: Students practice shape recognition and composition through paper collage techniques
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by practicing shape combination with collage materials
realWorldConnection: Magazine pictures are made of shapes that can be cut and rearranged

title: Lignes de mouvement
oneGoal: Students practice drawing action lines that show movement and energy
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by practicing advanced storytelling through dynamic lines
realWorldConnection: Comic books use special lines to show speed and movement

title: Motifs personnalisés
oneGoal: Students practice creating their own unique patterns using learned shapes and lines
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by practicing personal pattern creation with cultural inspiration
realWorldConnection: Designers create new patterns for fabric, wallpaper, and products

title: Collaborations créatives
oneGoal: Students practice teamwork by creating large group artworks using lines and shapes
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by practicing personal expression within group projects
realWorldConnection: Many public artworks are created by teams of artists working together

title: Galerie d'exposition
oneGoal: Students practice presentation skills by displaying and explaining their line and shape artworks
progression: Builds on Lesson 14 by practicing communication about artistic learning and growth
realWorldConnection: Art galleries and museums help artists share their work with the community
